extDescription.message: Sends browser downloads, page links and videos to the DownloadManager app for Windows.

fallbackNotice.message: DownloadManager did not take the download ($1). The browser downloads it instead.

errorTimeout.message: the app did not answer in time

errorBlobMedia.message: This video is played from data inside the page: use the “Download this video” button that appears on the page.

errorNotDownloadable.message: This link cannot be downloaded with DownloadManager.

errorNoLinks.message: This page has no links to download.

errorUnknownMedia.message: This video was not loaded by the page.

mediaTerms.message: This site's terms of service do not allow downloading its videos, so DownloadManager does not offer it.

mediaDrm.message: This video is protected (DRM). It cannot be downloaded, and DownloadManager does not get around protections.

mediaLive.message: This is a live stream: only complete videos can be downloaded.

mediaAppOutdated.message: Update DownloadManager to version 0.6 or later to download videos.

mediaEstimateHint.message: Sizes are estimates from the stream's bit rate.

modeAutoHint.message: Matching downloads go to the app; if it does not answer, the browser keeps them.

modeMenuHint.message: The browser downloads as usual; right-click a link to use the app.

queueLabel.message: Queue for downloads from the browser

queueHint.message: The queues are those created in the app.

alwaysSitesLabel.message: Always intercept from these sites (any type and size)

altHint.message: Alt+click a link to let the browser download it this once.

queueMissing.message: $1 (not found: the main queue is used)

state_missing.message: App not registered for this browser

checkIntro.message: The extension talks to the app through a small helper (the “native host”) that the app registers for each browser.

checkAppStopped.message: not running (starts on the first download)

checkText_running.message: Everything works: downloads, “Download all” and the video button.

checkText_ready.message: Everything works. The app is not running now: it starts by itself when the browser sends it something.

checkText_outdated.message: The app answers but is an older version: plain downloads work, videos and “Download all” need DownloadManager 0.6 or later.

checkText_missing.message: This browser cannot find the app's native host. It is registered by the app itself, for the current Windows user.

checkText_forbidden.message: The host is registered, but not for this extension's ID (for example a copy loaded from another folder in Firefox).

checkText_error.message: The app could not be reached. Try again; if it persists, restart DownloadManager.

checkStepStart.message: Start DownloadManager once: it registers itself for Chrome, Edge, Opera, Brave and Firefox.

checkStepRegister.message: Or press “Register”: the browser asks to open DownloadManager, which registers the host again.

checkStepFirefox.message: Firefox needs DownloadManager 0.6 or later (earlier versions do not register for Firefox).

checkStepChromium.message: Opera, Brave and Chromium use Chrome's registration; restart the browser if it was open during the registration.
